results.corrected_title: Bulk Infrastructure warns a data-centre freeze could hit projects that have already reserved power
results.corrected_summary: Bulk Infrastructure CEO Jon Gravråk says a 40-50 MW data centre needs NOK 6-7 billion of investment before construction starts. Several parties in the Storting want a temporary halt on new data centres while the government drafts stricter rules. Bulk warns that a pause would have major consequences if it also covers projects that have already reserved power capacity and invested heavily.
key_facts: Upfront investment before construction: NOK 6-7 billion
Several Storting parties want a temporary halt on new data centres
Bulk warns against a freeze that covers projects with reserved power
results.issues: Paywalled; only introduction read; single source.

results.corrected_title: Onmanorama: 135,446 tech layoffs in 2026 to 29 Oct, citing layoffs.fyi
results.corrected_summary: Onmanorama, citing layoffs.fyi data to 29 October, reports 135,446 tech layoffs at 334 companies in 2026. The AI-attribution figure of 93,217 could not be confirmed on layoffs.fyi and the article is internally inconsistent about it.
results.issues: Refuted: AI-attribution figure unconfirmed and article internally inconsistent.

results.corrected_title: Microsoft reportedly takes option to more than double Nscale Texas contract, withdrew from UK site
results.corrected_summary: According to the Financial Times as relayed by Digi.no, Microsoft has taken an option to more than double its signed contract at Nscale's Texas data centre. The option is valued at several tens of billions of dollars. In October Microsoft reportedly withdrew as lead customer for Nscale's first UK data centre, which is heavily delayed by missing power supply.
key_facts: Digi.no article dated 2026-11-05, based on an FT report
Option would more than double an already signed Texas contract
Option value: several tens of billions of USD
Microsoft withdrew in October as lead customer for Nscale's first UK data centre
Reason given: heavy delay from missing power supply
results.issues: Paywalled secondhand report. Nscale/Aker Stargate Norway link not verified; do not include.

results.corrected_title: MIT's Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win 2026 Pritzker Prize for AI in Science Research Excellence
results.corrected_summary: MIT News reports on 2 November 2026 that Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins won the 2026 Pritzker Prize for AI in Science Research Excellence. The University of Chicago awards it in partnership with Caltech. The recognition is for AI-driven antibiotic discovery, including halicin (Cell, 2020) and abaucin (2023).
key_facts: Prize is awarded by the University of Chicago in partnership with Caltech
Halicin was identified by a deep learning model trained on about 2,500 molecules, published in Cell in 2020
Abaucin (2023) is a narrow-spectrum antibiotic active against A. baumannii
